toegepas.voor: kom Gauteng se staaf se bopunt by daardie getal
toegepas.na: kom die bopunt van Gauteng se staaf by daardie getal
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two stacked possessive 'se' forms are clumsy; one 'van' phrase reads more easily.
toegepas.fout: Two stacked possessives ('Gauteng se staaf se bopunt') read clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One 'van' phrase reads more easily and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.voor: Party stawe staan hoog en ander
toegepas.na: Party stawe staan hoog, en ander
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party stawe staan hoog' and 'ander staan baie laag' are two full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma goes before 'en'.

toegepas.voor: staan die laagste en daar woon
toegepas.na: staan die laagste, en daar woon
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Noord-Kaap se staaf staan die laagste' and 'daar woon die minste mense' are two full clauses.

toegepas.voor: vergelyk getalle mense en die ander
toegepas.na: vergelyk getalle mense, en die ander
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die een grafiek vergelyk' and 'die ander vergelyk' are two full clauses.

toegepas.voor: Gauteng is die kleinste provinsie in oppervlakte van al nege.
toegepas.na: Gauteng het die kleinste oppervlakte van al nege provinsies.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'van al nege' stranded after 'in oppervlakte' is awkward; the reworded sentence is more natural and means the same.
toegepas.fout: 'die kleinste provinsie in oppervlakte van al nege' is awkward, with 'van al nege' left hanging after 'in oppervlakte'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het die kleinste oppervlakte van al nege provinsies' is natural, keeps the protected word 'oppervlakte' and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Noord-Kaap is die grootste provinsie in oppervlakte en het die minste mense
toegepas.na: Noord-Kaap het die grootste oppervlakte en die minste mense
toegepas.rede_vinder: Matches the Gauteng sentence and is smoother; the meaning is unchanged.
toegepas.fout: 'die grootste provinsie in oppervlakte' is stiff and no longer matches the Gauteng sentence once change 8 is applied.
toegepas.rede_keurder: This matches change 8, keeps 'oppervlakte' and the same claims about area and population, and reads more smoothly.

toegepas.voor: vir die hele provinsie en die mense woon
toegepas.na: vir die hele provinsie, en die mense woon
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n Digtheidstaaf wys' and 'die mense woon nie oral ewe dig nie' are two full clauses.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n vol stad' is vague and unidiomatic; 'n stad vol mense' says plainly what is full.
toegepas.fout: ''n vol stad' is vague and does not sound natural in Afrikaans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n stad vol mense' says plainly what the city is full of, adds no new fact and still contrasts with the nearly empty semi-desert.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'naas' is formal for Grade 6; 'saam met' says the same thing more plainly.
toegepas.fout: 'naas' is formal and literary for a Grade 6 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: In both versions you need the map as well as this graph, so the preposition swap does not change who needs what, and 'saam met' is plainer.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The dangling 'op' is colloquial; 'daarop' completes the phrase in standard written Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n skaal met getalle op' is the normal Afrikaans stranded-preposition pattern (like 'n bord met name op'), so 'daarop' is only a different way of saying it.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'hom' could point to the province or to its name; 'langsaan' removes the unclear pronoun.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Whether 'hom' points to the province or to its name, the reader does the same thing, so it is not really ambiguous; 'langsaan af' is a sideways move.

na_skrywer.voor: Elke bevolkingsdigtheid in die lys is bereken deur die provinsie se mense deur sy oppervlakte in vierkante kilometer te deel.
na_skrywer.na: Vir elke bevolkingsdigtheid in die lys is die getal mense in die provinsie gedeel deur sy oppervlakte in vierkante kilometer.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Removes the double 'deur ... deur' and says the number of people is divided, not the people themselves; the meaning is unchanged.
na_skrywer.fout: The double 'deur ... deur' makes a reader stumble, and 'die provinsie se mense ... deel' loosely says the people are divided rather than their number.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the proposal drops 'is bereken' and makes the density the thing operated on ('Vir elke bevolkingsdigtheid ... is die getal gedeel'), which turns the logic around, so this explanation of how density is worked out needs a writer's fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Die getal wat jy kry as jy 'n totaal gelyk verdeel.
vlae.rede: The definition does not say what the total is shared among (the number of items), so it reads as incomplete; fixing it would add content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
